heading: Direct grants for the preservation of properties included on National Register

tree.heading: Administration of Program.—
tree.text: The Secretary shall administer a program of direct grants for the preservation of properties included on the National Register.

tree.heading: Available Amount.—
tree.text: Funds to support the program annually shall not exceed 10 percent of the amount appropriated annually for the Historic Preservation Fund.

children.heading: In general.—
children.text: Grants under this section may be made by the Secretary, in consultation with the appropriate State Historic Preservation Officer—
National Historic Landmarks that are threatened with demolition or impairment; and
historic property of World Heritage significance;
for demonstration projects that will provide information concerning professional methods and techniques having application to historic property;
for the training and development of skilled labor in trades and crafts, and in analysis and curation, relating to historic preservation; and
to assist individuals or small businesses within any historic district included on the National Register to remain within the district.

children.heading: Limit on certain grants.—
children.text: A grant may be made under subparagraph (A) or (D) of paragraph (1) only to the extent that the project cannot be carried out in as effective a manner through the use of an insured loan under section 303901 of this title.
